label: Clickable Discount
purpose: Display one or two short promotional messages that apply a discount when clicked
_notes:
Two independent message slots, each with inline_richtext text (must NOT be wrapped in

tags) and an optional icon. icon_1/icon_2 are Material Symbols icon font names (e.g. 'local_offer'); custom_icon_1/custom_icon_2 are image overrides and must be left empty. discount_code is intentionally excluded — it must match a real, active Shopify discount code that the AI cannot know, so text_1/text_2 should describe the promotion generally (e.g. 'Click to apply your discount') rather than asserting a specific unverified code. Sizing, alignment, background and color settings are pure layout and excluded.
